about: SCION 34 trace, measured from the render: x_screen/y_screen = alpha centroid of the rendered dog (px, in that frame's camera); x_world_measured back-projects it through the camera (two fixed set-ups, a cut at 20.5 s); facing = +1 when the rendered muzzle points to the door; posture from the rendered height; x_score = the score x the dog was placed at.

onsets_measured.signal: dog drops > 3 px or moves away > 1.5 px from its 0.9 s place
the top of the dog rises 3 px above its lowest (cowering) height
rendered muzzle turns away from the door (or the rear view shows)

onsets_measured.choice: refuse: the back shown in profile
onsets_measured.signal: whole body in profile facing away
rendered muzzle points to the door again
body centre moves toward the door > 1.5 px
rendered top of the dog 4 px below its walking height
muzzle lifts and reaches into the doorway (> 2 px)
